[1/3] Count an abandoned run's attempt and cleared boards when Quit run returns to the menu

impact_assessment.why: Clearing two Focus boards then quitting leaves the menu at EYE LV 1 - 0 clears - 0 runs; quitting erases all lifetime progress even though the boards were cleared and a run was played
impact_assessment.benefits: Quit run keeps the attempt and its cleared boards in profile runs/clears/bestStreak; the menu's lifetime stats reflect how people actually play
impact_assessment.risks: contract: quit path only, finished result path unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: profile fields increment once and persist via versioned save
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing pure abandonedTotals test; same two-clear-quit menu screenshot pair; finished-run check proves no double count; full gates

[1/3] Make a blocked profile save read-only: no unpersisted freeze, first-clear or lifetime claims

impact_assessment.why: With a future-format afterimage.profile, a perfect daily win says Streak freeze earned and First Daily clear, updates in-memory freezes/runs/wins, but the raw file is untouched; reload loses all of it

[1/3] Add a visible seconds readout and live accessible value to the timer bar

impact_assessment.why: The only clock is a 3px bar with aria-label 'Time remaining' and no value; players cannot read exact seconds and screen readers cannot hear the remaining time
impact_assessment.benefits: A right-aligned 12s-style readout updates once per second, and the timer's aria-label carries the current value for assistive tech
impact_assessment.risks: contract: timer visual/ARIA only, no timing/score changes; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: data-time updated only when the whole second changes
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing timerLabel and shell contract tests; same Focus 12s crop before/after; played run checks 12s-to-11s and a wrong-pick life loss; full gates

[1/3] Give the Focus lives dots a visible count and an accessible N-of-M label

impact_assessment.why: The lives HUD is three unlabeled dots: sighted players must count them and assistive tech gets only the word Focus, with no lives value
impact_assessment.benefits: A visible numeric count sits beside the dots, and the dots expose '2 of 3 focus remaining' through ARIA, updating after every loss
impact_assessment.risks: contract: HUD value/ARIA only, no lives logic/timing changes; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no persistence changes
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing livesLabel and shell contract tests; same HUD crop before/after and after a wrong pick; played wrong-pick run; full gates
